focus.item: Foundations of game engine development: Mathematics
focus.desc: Study vector spaces, matrix multiplication, and baseline linear algebra.

focus.item: Programming: Principles and Practice Using C++
focus.desc: Master pointers, references, manual memory allocation, and STL containers.
Implement basic canvas, ray casting, shading, and sphere intersections.
Start with window setups, coordinate systems, and basic rendering shaders.

deliverable.desc: A standalone, CPU-bound C++ rendering application capable of shading spheres, shadows, and reflections.

math.desc: Vector/matrix math and coordinate spaces (local, world, view, projection).

algoDS.desc: Array of Structures (AoS) vs. Structure of Arrays (SoA), Memory Alignment & Padding (alignas), and Fixed-size pools to avoid heap overhead.
Array and Two-Pointer problems with a focus on space complexity and minimal allocations.

tasks.title: Foundations of game engine development: Rendering
Learn basic RenderDoc shader & texture frame debugging

focus.desc: Study Core Profile features, texturing, lighting equations, and shader languages (GLSL).
Leverage lectures to match graphics theories directly with active code.
Go over differentiation rules and differentiation applications.

focus.item: Foundations of game engine development: Rendering
focus.desc: Study lighting models, shading math, shadow algorithms, and environment maps.
Build real-time interactive parameters, light controllers, and camera toggles.
Analyze bound pipelines, uniform states, and step through shader variables.
Draw line arrays, coordinate axes, and bounding boxes in 3D world space.

deliverable.desc: A 3D mesh renderer loading files via Assimp, custom scene graphs, real-time lighting (Blinn-Phong), and shadow mapping.

math.desc: Calculate change over time, surface normals of complex geometry, and ray differentials for texture filtering.

algoDS.desc: Scene Graphs using trees or Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs) to propagate spatial transformations parent-to-child.
Iterative Depth-First Search (DFS) and Breadth-First Search (BFS) using custom Stacks to traverse scene graphs.
Binary Trees, N-ary Trees, and Graph Traversal (DFS/BFS) Medium problems.

focus.desc: Focus on spatial partitioning data structures and geometry processing chapters.
Review integrations and partial derivatives chapters.
Integrate Tracy Profiler to identify CPU/GPU frame boundary bottlenecks.

deliverable.desc: Integrate View Frustum Culling, spatial partitioning (Octree/BVH), and post-processing pipelines (Bloom/HDR).

math.desc: Numerical integration for physics physics loops. Partial derivatives for texture coordinate (u, v) gradients across triangles.

algoDS.desc: Bounding Volume Hierarchies (BVH) nesting shapes in Axis-Aligned Bounding Boxes (AABBs), Quadtrees (2D) & Octrees (3D) for frustum culling, and kD-Trees.
Ray-AABB intersection testing and hierarchical tree traversal.
Implement a custom Bounding Volume Hierarchy (BVH) from scratch in your Ray Tracer or Engine repository.

tasks.title: Diagnose Vulkan device queues & pipeline states with RenderDoc

focus.desc: Work through swapchain setups, command buffers, memory allocation, and custom render passes.
Complete Stewart's vector calculus and numerical methods chapters.
Verify device queues, descriptor layouts, and memory barriers under Vulkan.

deliverable.desc: A basic Vulkan renderer setting up explicit pipelines and device buffers to draw textured meshes.

math.desc: Gradients for Signed Distance Fields (SDFs). Double and line integrals to solve the PBR Rendering Equation. Monte Carlo numerical integrations.

algoDS.desc: Half-Edge data structure for mesh representations (polygon mesh adjacencies lookup for geometry processing).
Radix Sort or Merge Sort for depth-sorting transparent geometry from back-to-front every frame.
Standard sorting algorithm mechanics and advanced Graph problems (Adjacency Lists).
